description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Goteo Payment system, specifically testing payment methods, including adding, removing, and retrieving payment methods, as well as default settings.

classes.name: MockPaymentMethod
classes.description: A mock class extending AbstractPaymentMethod, used for testing purposes.

classes.name: PaymentTest
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of the Payment class and its methods in the Goteo payment system.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests that a Payment object can be instantiated and is of the correct type.

methods.name: testAddMethod
methods.description: Tests adding payment methods, handling exceptions, and verifying method existence.

methods.name: testGetMethods
methods.description: Tests retrieving all payment methods, with and without a user context.

methods.name: testGetMethod
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific payment method by identifier.

methods.name: testDefaultMethod
methods.description: Tests setting and retrieving the default payment method.

methods.name: testRemoveMethod
methods.description: Tests removing payment methods and verifying removal.
